source.label: CIViC: genes with accepted clinical evidence (levels A and B)

method: CIViC GraphQL API (https://civicdb.org/api/graphql): every accepted evidence item, grouped by the gene of its molecular profile (a gene feature, or each named partner gene of a fusion feature); one item per gene, with its accepted evidence count and the count at each evidence level (A validated to E inferential); kept when at least one item is level A (validated) or B (clinical evidence). Fusions count for both partner genes. CIViC content is CC0 1.0; cite Griffith et al., Nat Genet 2017.
